Definition: from G5225; existency or proprietorship, i.e. (concretely) property, wealth:--goods, substance.
BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, hýparxis is the word for goods, property, substance. In Acts 2:45, the text says "And sold their possessions and goods."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of hýparxis I do not force more than it gives: goods, property, substance.
